segments.text: Stop chasing happiness. Chasing it is the exact reason you can't catch it.
Frankl said happiness can't be pursued. It can only ensue. A side effect of losing yourself in something bigger than you.
Aim straight at it and it flees, like a butterfly you're snatching at. Aim past yourself, at work, a person, a cause, and it lands on you sideways.
And this is the one idea in his book that hard data later confirmed. Purpose first. The good feeling follows on its own.
That's Man's Search for Meaning. Honest verdict on the channel.
